title: Serpentine Whisper Chain — Silver
metal: rhodium silver tone (PVD rhodium coating on surgical stainless steel), bright cool mirror polish, one tone only
lock: Rhodium silver tone. 1 smooth round snake chain, 2 mm thick, 40 cm plus a 5 cm curb-link extender and lobster clasp. At the front, 1 cushion-cut clear cubic zirconia, 10 mm (5x the chain's thickness), in an open 4-prong basket hung directly from 1 small bail. Must stay 1 stone in 4 prongs, basket straight on the bail, never a halo, an added jump ring or a larger stone.
morph: The pendant. Image models add a jump ring between the bail and the basket (b04-4h was held for exactly this), wrap the stone in a halo or extra stones, swell it past 10 mm (the true stone is only 5x the chain's thickness, never 10x), or recut it as a sharp-cornered princess, radiant or emerald cut. Second most likely: the snake chain becomes a cable, box or curb chain, or the metal drifts to the gold-tone twin.
sizeMm: Listed: chain 400 mm plus a 50 mm extender, 2 mm snake chain, 10 g; stone a cushion of about 10 mm in a fine 4-prong basket. Estimated from the worn photo (02): the whole drop, bail plus basket, is about 14-15 mm, the bail about a third of the stone's height. On the body (size guide 05): 40 cm sits at the base of the neck with the stone in the notch between the collarbones; 45 cm on the extender drops it about 2 cm lower. Referents: the stone is half a Rs 1 coin (20 mm), about the size of a little fingernail; the chain is as thick as a strand of spaghetti.
refNotes: Reused the ads-500 ids from products.md (also used by concept-50 c01) after checking they match the current listing. Ref 1 (plinth packshot) = listing 01, mean pixel difference 1.3/255 against ads-500/build/refs/serpentine-whisper-chain-silver__plinth.jpg; it is the clearest view of the whole build: snake chain, bail, basket windows, extender, lobster clasp and tag. Ref 2 (velvet bolster detail) = listing 03, difference 0.5/255 against __detail.jpg; it is the supplier's own photo, so use it for the chain's ridges, the 4 prongs and the extender, not for the bail junction or the stone's corners, which are soft at 640 px. For scale on skin, describe listing 02 (worn) in the prompt or import it if a shot needs a body reference; no new import was made.
claims: Waterproof, Tarnish Free, Hypoallergenic: all 3 are tagged, and the care text backs them ('Waterproof and tarnish free, so daily wear and water are fine'). Water imagery is allowed for this piece.
variants: 1 variant: Default Title, stock 23, rhodium silver tone. Show it (every photo is this variant). The 18k gold tone twin is a separate listing (serpentine-whisper-chain, Rs 1,299, stock 20): never in the same frame, camp or price line.
copyNotes: Use: rhodium silver tone, PVD rhodium, surgical stainless steel, snake chain, cushion-cut cubic zirconia, solitaire-style, one stone, 2 mm, 40 cm + 5 cm, 10 mm, 10 g, waterproof, tarnish free, hypoallergenic, the listing's own lines 'One stone, one smooth line of silver' and 'taken cool' (as 'silver tone'). Always print the full name with '— Silver'. Price Rs 899 (compare-at Rs 1,499). Avoid: diamond, solitaire diamond, sterling, white gold, platinum, 'silver' alone as the metal, 18k, gold, halo, pave, princess, radiant or emerald cut, cable, box or curb chain (the extender is the only curb links), choker (40 cm is base of the neck), huggie, and 'anti-tarnish' (say tarnish free, the tagged word). Never price it beside the gold-tone twin.
story: One cold drop of light on a line of liquid metal. The snake chain has no links to catch the eye, so it reads as a single poured stroke of mercury, and the 10 mm cushion sits at the bottom of it like an ice cube in a glass of water. Lovable because it is a solitaire-style ring you wear at the throat for Rs 899, waterproof, so it can go in the sea and the shower. Rhymes with a dewdrop at the tip of a blade of grass, a full stop at the end of a sentence, a single headlight on a night road, a raindrop on a wire, the moon on still water, a silver snake carrying one ice cube in its mouth. It is the cool twin of the gold Serpentine: give the gold, keep the silver. Best on dark, saturated grounds (charcoal, deep teal, ink, plum) or lilac, where the clear stone is the brightest point. Near the stock floor (23), so never the anchor of a set.

The chain runs over the roll, the pendant hangs on the left, and the extender hangs on the right with a lobster clasp and a small flat end tag. Rhodium silver tone. At 640 px the bail junction is soft and may read as a small loop, and the stone's corners look sharper than a cushion. Earlier rulings set basket-on-bail and a cushion cut. Identical to the ads-500 detail ref.
Packaging only: the blush Naira Petite box floating on a blush gradient. The piece is not shown.
Size guide: 40 cm at the base of the neck, 45 cm with the extender, against 36/50/60 cm. The diagram is drawn in a gold-brown line; that is the guide's style, not the metal.

finish: Bright, cool, high-polish rhodium silver tone; the snake chain's fine diagonal ridges catch a continuous line of light; the bail is a smooth mirror surface; the stone is a clear, fully faceted cushion with crisp sparkle.
